items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: Mr. U.H. Humphrey was staying in the same hotel we were staying in... I didn't get a chance to shake his head or anything.

ctx.x: Uh, I stood in Boston, uh, I stood in Boston a week. I was in Boston, uh, the one up there with the zip codes there, uh, and, uh, Lettercarys Convention up there for a week. And, uh, we performed up there for the convention. It's, uh, had a lot of big people there, uh, Mr. Humphrey was there, uh, Mr. Nixon, and, uh, and, uh,
Is it Willie Humphrey or Earl Humphrey? Uh, you would age, yeah.

Uh, no, neither one of them guys wasn't there. Uh, it's, uh, matter of fact, Mr. U.H. Humphrey was staying in the same hotel we were staying in, a summer set up there. Uh-huh. Uh, and, uh, I didn't get a chance to shake his head or anything. But, uh, he did like the way we performed, uh, playing this New Orleans jazz music, you know. It was sort of, all the other bands came over from all over the United States, was performing marches and we was playing New Orleans jazz and we got somewhat of a nice applause. So,…
